profiles.rule: Keep V15 measured-position relaxation and existing speed/impulse caps. Set every knee goal to -0.25 rad and each hip goal to -atan2(lower_fraction*sin(knee), upper_fraction+lower_fraction*cos(knee)), so the ideal sagittal foot center remains under its hip. Do not alter observations, standing gates or phase timeouts.
profiles.parameter_basis: Prospective modest flexion: about 14.3 degrees at the knee. In the exact S169 ideal two-link geometry this shortens the leg by about 2.7 mm and gives a nonzero first-order knee-to-foot-height derivative, unlike the fully straight goal. No optimum, load balance, clearance, native stability or behavioral improvement is proved by that geometry.
